subject: Hosted API commit uplift & tiering proposal — BrightCart Q3 expansion
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Mallory <andrew@brightcart.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Hosted API commit uplift & tiering proposal — BrightCart Q3 expansion

Andrew —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Based on your volume signals (peak seasonal traffic for campaigns), we recommend increasing your Hosted commit to reduce per-token unit cost and avoid soft-throttle risk during promotions. High level proposal:

- New monthly committed units: 10M tokens (current: 4M)
- Tiered rates: base rate reduced by ~18% above 6M/month
- Soft throttle window: increased burst allowance during promo weeks
- Term: 12 months with quarterly usage reviews

Attached: pricing-exhibit-brightcart.xlsx and a short commit-term-summary.docx.

If this looks reasonable, we can:
1) Lock pricing and present an SOW for signatures,
2) Schedule a short ops call to confirm burst windows and routing policies,
3) Coordinate legal for a one-off billing cadence if procurement needs it.

Can you share the procurement contact and any PO timelines? I can loop in our finance/legal for a limited-time onboarding credit.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Direct: +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: pricing-exhibit-brightcart.xlsx (spreadsheet), commit-term-summary.docx (doc)

From: Andrew Mallory <andrew@brightcart.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Sat, 12 Apr 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API commit uplift & tiering proposal — BrightCart Q3 expansion

Karthik —

Thanks — appreciate the fast follow. A couple quick questions before we loop procurement:

- Can you break the cost delta vs our current plan on a monthly basis (what we'd pay today vs proposed committed rate)?
- Is the burst allowance automatic during promo weeks or do we need a support ticket each time?
- Any minimum lead time for turning on the higher commit?

Procurement: our fiscal quarter closes 05/15; ideally we sign and have the new commit active by 06/01.

—Andrew
Andrew Mallory
Head of Growth, BrightCart
andrew@brightcart.com
+1 646-555-0123

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Mallory <andrew@brightcart.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Apr 2025 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Hosted API commit uplift & tiering proposal — BrightCart Q3 expansion

Andrew —

Attaching a one-page delta and a proposed SOW draft to make review easier (SOW_BrightCart_v1.pdf). Quick answers inline:

- Monthly cost comparison (sample month):
  * Current (4M committed): $23,600
  * Proposed (10M committed): $38,600
  * Net savings per token tier above 6M: ~18% on generation tokens

- Burst allowance: we include a promo burst pool (up to 25% of monthly commit) that is auto-enabled during calendar dates you specify. No ticket required if dates are pre-registered; otherwise a 24–48 hour ops window.

- Lead time: if you sign by 05/15 we can activate the new commit effective 06/01. We can also do a phased increase (start at 7M and step to 10M over two months) if that helps procurement cashflow.

Other notes:
- We can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $5k if SOW signs before 05/01 (finance-approved).
- Legal redlines are typically limited to data retention and SLAs; pricing exhibits are treated as appendices to the SOW.

Next step: I propose a 30-minute call this week to finalize the SOW and calendar for promo windows. Available: Mon 04/14 10–12 PDT or Tue 04/15 14–16 PDT.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Commercial Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_BrightCart_v1.pdf

From: Andrew Mallory <andrew@brightcart.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@brightcart.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RE: Hosted API commit uplift & tiering proposal — BrightCart Q3 expansion

Neha / Karthik —

This looks promising. Procurement has two asks before they will route a PO:

1) We need pricing locked in an exhibit attached to the SOW (fine).
2) Legal will want a short clause about routing fallback in case Redwood's primary region has an outage (can Redwood commit to a cross-region fallback policy or is that part of premium SLA?).

Also interested in the phased increase option — please include a one-line example of the step-up schedule in the SOW.

I'll introduce our procurement lead (Procurement Team) on the thread — they will drop required PO language and the target PO date. If we can get the SOW and exhibit in the next 48 hours we'll try to meet your 05/15 sign-by window.

Thanks,
Andrew

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Mallory <andrew@brightcart.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@brightcart.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Re: RE: Hosted API commit uplift & tiering proposal — BrightCart Q3 expansion

Andrew / Procurement —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per Neha's note we've attached the SOW draft and pricing exhibit for review; below are the immediate next steps so everyone is aligned:

- Neha/Finance to send final SOW + pricing exhibit (we just shared v1).
- Legal (Redwood) to propose fallback clause language — short summary to be included in the exhibit.
- Procurement to confirm PO cadence and any mandatory PO text.
- Ops call to lock promo dates once SOW is signed.

I've penciled a 30-minute slot for Wed 04/16 10:00 PDT for the ops alignment; sending a calendar invite. If Procurement wants to push the timeline, we can do the phased start (7M -> 10M over 60 days) with the same pricing tiers and pro-rated billing.

DocuSign link (draft): https://www.docusign.com/link/brightcart-sow
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/BRIGHT-4521

I'll coordinate legal and finance on our side and stay on this thread. Thanks — excited to get BrightCart set up for the promo season.

—Karthik
